pushId: basic=普通推掌（BuddahHandControl.PushBasicMap），charged=如来神掌蓄力弹（SkillDatabase.PushChargedMap → Skill_PushProjectileHands），charged_anti=反噬弹幕（SkillDatabase.PushChargedAntiMap → Skill_PushProjectileHands_Anti）
rotationSpeedDegPerSec: basic：鼠标转手速度上限 °/s，光标目标先平滑再按此限速（BuddahHandControl.rotationSpeedDegPerSec）；方向键回退与 AI 瞄准估算（AISkillCaster 经 HandRotationSpeed）也用它
windupSeconds: basic=pushWindupSeconds 前摇；charged / charged_anti=buildUpSeconds 蓄力
delayedPushActionSeconds: charged：蓄力后延迟推掌动作 s
colliderSize: charged：projectileColliderSize；basic 的 hitbox 尺寸见 SkillConstant
